adjacent_doc_lines: /// Deserialize an OSCAL artifact from a string in the specified format.
/// Detects the OSCAL model type (Catalog vs `ComponentDefinition`) and

/// - Every format uses `ForgeError::ExportInvalidOscal` for an unsupported or
///   malformed OSCAL envelope after parsing.

rows.name: oscal_model_from_value

adjacent_doc_lines: /// Deserialize an OSCAL artifact from XML.

rows.name: deserialize_from_xml

rows.name: detect_xml_root_element

adjacent_doc_lines: /// Deserialize an OSCAL artifact from YAML.

///   malformed OSCAL envelope after parsing.

/// confinement, even when the caller caps input bytes.
